payload.reason: The evidence provides sufficient information to define the baseline systems used in the study.

claims.text: The baseline systems include a traditional phrase-based statistical machine translation (SMT) and a neural machine translation (NMT) system.
The training data for the baseline systems consists of KyTea-segmented Japanese texts and pyvi-segmented Vietnamese texts.
The aim of the baseline systems is to establish reproducible NMT systems for further research.
